title: GenerationNote
description: Something somebody wrote beside a generation — a remark about the text, not part of it. It stays its own record so the generation reads as the model left it.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The generation the note is about, by its id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The working session the note was written in, by that session's id in the system that holds it. The note is attributed to the session, not to a wallet: who was at the keyboard is the session's own business.

body.description: What they wrote, in their words.

updatedAt.description: When it was last rewritten. A note is editable, so this differs from createdAt once it has been.
